segments.an11.4:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an11.4:1.2: “āvuso bhikkhave”ti [bhikkhavoti (sī. syā. pī.) evaṃ sabbattha a. ni. 10.4].
segments.an11.4:1.3: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.an11.4:2.2: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti pāmojjaṃ,
segments.an11.4:2.3: pāmojje asati pāmojjavipannassa hatūpanisā hoti pīti,
segments.an11.4:2.4: pītiyā asati pītivipannassa hatūpanisā hoti passaddhi,
segments.an11.4:2.5: passaddhiyā asati passaddhivipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti sukhaṃ,
segments.an11.4:2.6: sukhe asati sukhavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi,
segments.an11.4:2.7: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ,
segments.an11.4:2.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatūpanisā hoti nibbidā,
segments.an11.4:2.9: nibbidāya asati nibbidāvipannassa hatūpaniso hoti virāgo,
segments.an11.4:2.10: virāge asati virāgavipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an11.4:3.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, tacopi… pheggupi… sāropi na pāripūriṃ gacchati.
segments.an11.4:3.2: Evamevaṃ kho, āvuso, dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti avippaṭisāro,
segments.an11.4:3.3: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti pāmojjaṃ…pe…
segments.an11.4:4.2: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti pāmojjaṃ,
segments.an11.4:4.3: pāmojje sati pāmojjasampannassa upanisasampannā hoti pīti,
segments.an11.4:4.4: pītiyā sati pītisampannassa upanisasampannā hoti passaddhi,
segments.an11.4:4.5: passaddhiyā sati passaddhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti sukhaṃ,
segments.an11.4:4.6: sukhe sati sukhasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi,
segments.an11.4:4.7: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ,
segments.an11.4:4.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampannā hoti nibbidā,
segments.an11.4:4.9: nibbidāya sati nibbidāsampannassa upanisasampanno hoti virāgo,
segments.an11.4:4.10: virāge sati virāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an11.4:5.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ gacchati, tacopi… pheggupi… sāropi pāripūriṃ gacchati.
segments.an11.4:5.2: Evamevaṃ kho, āvuso, sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro,
segments.an11.4:5.3: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti pāmojjaṃ…pe…

lines: Kevalañcettha ādito pañcasu nibbidāvirāgaṃ dvidhā bhinditvā ekādasaṅgāni katāni.
Dasame janitasminti kammakilesehi nibbatte, jane etasminti vā janetasmiṃ, manussesūti attho.
Janitasmiṃ-saddo eva vā i-kārassa e-kāraṃ katvā “janetasmi”nti vutto.
Janitasminti sāmaññaggahaṇepi yattha catuvaṇṇasamaññā, tattheva manussaloke.
Khattiyo seṭṭhoti ayaṃ lokasamaññāpi manussalokeyeva, na devakāye brahmakāye vāti dassetuṃ “ye gottapaṭisārino”ti vuttaṃ.
Paṭisarantīti “ahaṃ gotamo, ahaṃ kassapo”ti paṭi paṭi attano gottaṃ anussaranti paṭijānanti vāti attho.
